newsitem.title: UK: Lower futures, demand push NWE oil products down.
newsitem.headline: Lower futures, demand push NWE oil products down.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly lower on weaker futures and poor demand on Wednesday, traders said.

Gasoline was flat in dull trade. Eurograde barges were talked at $207/$209 for running refinery and $207/$208.50 for fob Rotterdam. Naphtha was also steady with June swaps talked around $191/$192 in similarly quiet conditions.
Gas oil eased lower as futures sagged under the weight of bearish stocks data. Heating oil barges traded at June IPE +$2.50 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges lost $2 on the day on aggressive selling.
Low sulphur was held up by swaps to stay notionally at the $95 level of the last cargo deal.
